observations: Seller text claims they tested it yesterday, but no new photos/videos were provided.
Photos remain the same: truck-mounted borehole drilling rig parked; no visible drilling operation or test run evidence.

claims.evidence: Photos 0-2 show a truck-mounted drilling rig with mast/boom and drilling assembly.
No drilling/test operation shown in photos; only parked equipment.
Seller says they tested it, but there is no video/start-up/operating evidence provided.
No service invoice/receipt or service stickers shown in photos; seller provides no new proof.
No close-up inventory of consumables/parts (bit/rods/hoses/cables/control panel) in provided images.
No manufacturer plate/serial number readable in photos.

risks.risk: Working status cannot be confirmed remotely (hydraulics/winch/rotary/drilling head may fail under load).
risks.proof: Short video of a full test: engine start + mast/boom movement + drilling head/rotary/winch action (or hydraulic cycle) while operating.
risks.if_unproven: Price as not proven working (worst case: needs inspection/repairs).

risks.risk: Exact make/model not readable, affecting parts availability and value.
risks.proof: Clear close-up photo of the truck and rig nameplates/serial plates showing model numbers.
risks.if_unproven: Price as generic truck-mounted borehole drilling rig with unknown model/config.

risks.risk: Completeness of drilling consumables/parts not verifiable from wide shots.
risks.proof: Photo inventory with close-ups of bit, rods, hoses, cables, control box, and any included accessories/spares.
risks.if_unproven: Price as incomplete/unknown accessories (assume buyer may need replacements).

risks.proof: Dealer service invoice/receipt with date and/or service stickers visible on engine/rig.

risks.risk: Structural/rigging/hydraulic wear/damage not assessable from these angles.
risks.proof: Close-ups of mast joints, hydraulic cylinder rods, weld points, and any cracks/bends.
risks.if_unproven: Price as having possible wear/damage requiring inspection.

proof_requests: Send a short operating video from the same location: engine start + mast/boom movement + drilling head/rotary/winch action (even 30–60 seconds).
Send clear close-up photos of the truck and rig nameplates/serial plates (model numbers must be readable).
Send close-up inventory photos of the drilling consumables/parts you claim are complete (bit, rods, hoses, cables, control box).
Send the dealer service invoice/receipt (date visible) or photos of service stickers on the engine/rig.
response.reason: The seller’s statement that they tested it is not proof without an operating video and readable identification plates. With no new evidence, the “fully working/serviced/complete” claims remain unverified, so pricing must stay at worst-case until proof is provided.
